tl.d: Your Smite and Penance spells deal 10% increased damage to targets afflicted with your Holy Fire.
Increases your damage with Wands by 25%.
Increases the damage and healing of your instant cast spells by 5%.
Reduces the threat generated by your Holy spells by 30% and reduces the duration of Stun, Fear, and Silence effects inflicted on you by 15%.
Improves your chance to hit with Holy spells by 18%.
Increases the damage absorbed by your Power Word: Shield by 20%.

Gives you a 100% chance to gain Focused Casting for 6 sec after being the victim of a melee or ranged critical strike. The Focused Casting effect prevents you from losing casting time when taking damage and increases your resistance to Interrupt effects by 20%.
Reduces the mana cost of your Smite, Holy Fire, and instant cast spells by 10%.
When activated, reduces the Mana cost of your next spell by 100% and increases its critical effect chance by 25% if it is a non-periodic spell and capable of a critical effect.
Allows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.
Increases the Armor bonus of your Inner Fire spell by 45% and increases its total charges by 12.
Increases your total Intellect by 15%.
Reduces the cooldown on your Power Word: Shield spell by 4 sec and reduces its mana cost by 15%.
Reduces the casting time of your Mana Burn spell by 1.0 sec.
Launches a volley of holy light at the target, causing 45 Holy damage to an enemy, or 134 healing to an ally, instantly and every 1 sec for 2 sec.

Your heals from Flash Heal, Binding Heal, Lesser Heal, Heal, Greater Heal, and Penance gain 10% increased critical strike chance when cast on targets with Weakened Soul, and reduce the remaining duration of Weakened Soul on their target by 5 sec.
Your critical heals create a protective shield on the target, absorbing 15% of the amount healed. Lasts 12 sec.
Infuses the target with power, increasing their spell damage and healing done by 20% for 15 sec.
Gives you a 70% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while casting any spell.
Increases the amount healed by your Renew spell by 15%.
Increases the critical effect chance of your Holy spells by 5%.
Reduces all spell damage taken by 10%.
Reduces the casting time of your Smite, Holy Fire, Heal, and Greater Heal spells by 0.5 sec.

Causes an explosion of holy light around the caster, causing 26 to 30 Holy damage to all enemy targets within 10 yards and healing all party members within 10 yards for 50 to 57. These effects cause no threat.

After being struck by a melee or ranged critical hit, or suffering more than 30% of your maximum Health from a single attack, heal 25% of the damage taken over 6 sec. Refreshing this effect carries over any remaining healing.
Your non-periodic critical heals increase your target's Armor by 25% for 15 sec.
Increases the range of your Smite and Holy Fire spells and the radius of your Prayer of Healing and Holy Nova spells by 20%.
Reduces the Mana cost of your Lesser Heal, Heal, Greater Heal, Penance, and Prayer of Mending spells by 15%.
Increases your Holy damage done by 5%, and gives a 10% chance each time your Holy Fire spell deals periodic damage for your next Holy Nova to cost no Mana.
Heals a friendly target and the caster for 236 to 284. Low threat.
When you cast a healing spell, gain Mana equal to 10% of the base cost of the spell if your previous heal was a different spell.

Upon death, the priest becomes the Spirit of Redemption for 15 sec. The Spirit of Redemption cannot move, attack, be attacked or targeted by any spells or effects. While in this form the priest can cast any healing spell free of cost. When the effect ends, the priest dies.
Increases your spell healing by up to 25% of your total Spirit and your spell damage by up to 8% of your total Spirit.
Increases the amount healed by your spells by 10%.

Places a spell on the target that heals them (scales with healing power) the next time they take damage or receive non-periodic healing. When the heal occurs, Prayer of Mending jumps to a party or raid member within 20 yards. Jumps up to 5 times and lasts 30 sec after each jump. This spell can only be placed on one target at a time per caster.
Improves your chance to hit with Shadow spells by 5%.
Gives your Shadow damage spells a 10% chance to stun the target for 3 sec.

Gives you a 100% chance to increase your Spirit by 100% for 15 sec after killing a non-trivial target or when an enemy afflicted by your Vampiric Embrace dies. For the duration, 50% of your Mana regeneration will continue while casting.
Reduces the threat generated by your Shadow spells by 30%.
Increases the duration of your Shadow Word: Pain spell by 6 sec.
Increases the range of your offensive Shadow spells by 20%.
Reduces the cooldown of your Mind Blast spell by 2.5 sec.
Reduces the cooldown of your Psychic Scream spell by 4 sec.
Assault the target's mind with Shadow energy, causing 63 Shadow damage over 3 sec and slowing their movement speed by 50%.
Your Mind Flay now deals 20% more damage, gains 10 yards increased range, but slows the target's movement speed by 20%.
Decreases the cooldown of your Fade ability by 6 sec.
Afflicts your target with Shadow energy that causes all party members to be healed for 20% of any Shadow spell damage you deal for 30 sec.
Your Shadow damage spells have a 100% chance to increase the Shadow damage you deal by 2% for 15 sec, stacking up to 5 times.
Silences the target, preventing them from casting spells for 5 sec and interrupting their spellcasts for 3 sec.
Reduces the mana cost of your Devouring Plague by 50%. Targets that die while Devouring Plague is active spread it, jumping to a nearby enemy within 10 yds for the remaining duration.
Increases Shadow Word: Death's critical strike chance on targets at or below 20% health by 30%.
Increases your Shadow damage done by 10%.

Assume Shadowform, increasing your Shadow damage by 10%, reducing the Mana cost of all Shadow spells by 50%, increasing the critical strike damage bonus of your Shadow spells by 100%, and reducing Physical damage taken by you by 15%. However, you may not cast healing spells while in this form.

a.d: Heal your target for 157 to 181.
Power infuses the target, increasing their Stamina by 70 for 1 hour.
Smite an enemy for 167 to 186 Holy damage.
A word of darkness that causes 762 Shadow damage over 18 sec.

Draws on the soul of the party member to shield them, absorbing 950 damage. Lasts 30 sec. While the shield holds, spellcasting will not be interrupted by damage. Once shielded, the target cannot be shielded again for 15 sec.
Fade out, discouraging enemies from attacking you for 10 sec.
Heals the target of 830 damage over 15 sec.
Confuses up to 5 enemies within 8 yds for 3 sec. Any damage taken will break the effect.
Instantly heals the caster for 1318 to 1546.
Instantly heals a friendly target below 50% Health for 1318 to 1546 and removes Weakened Soul from that target. Cannot be cast on self.
Weakens the target enemy, reducing melee attack power by 204 and reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 20%. Lasts 2 min.
Blasts the target for 485 to 511 Shadow damage, but causes a high amount of threat.
Brings a dead player back to life with 750 health and 1000 mana. Cannot be cast when in combat.
Rains starshards down on the enemy target's head, causing 1800 Arcane damage over 6 sec.
The next melee attack on the caster will cause 56 Shadow damage and reduce the attacker's melee attack power by 204 for 2 min.
A burst of Holy energy fills the caster, increasing armor by 1395. Each melee or ranged damage hit against the priest will remove one charge. Lasts 10 min or until 20 charges are used.
Removes 1 disease from the friendly target.
The caster lets out a psychic scream, causing 5 enemies within 8 yards to flee for 8 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect.
Heal your target for 634 to 713.
Dispels magic on the target, removing 2 harmful spells from a friend or 2 beneficial spells from an enemy.
Chastise the target, causing 272 to 306 Holy damage and Immobilizing them for up to 2 sec. Only works against Humanoids. This spell causes very low threat.

Place a Holy ward on an ally for 30 sec. The next time this ally takes damage dropping their Health below 35%, they will gain a shield absorbing 926 damage and begin healing for 670 Health over 15 sec. A target may be affected by only one Contingency Plan.
Cannibalize 1640 of your own Health over 15 sec to gain (1640 + Spirit) Mana.
Afflicts the target with a disease that causes 848 Shadow damage over 24 sec. Damage caused by the Devouring Plague heals the caster.
Reduces the chance you'll be hit by melee and ranged attacks by 50% for 15 sec or until you are missed 3 times.
Wards the friendly target against Fear. The next Fear effect used against the target will fail, using up the ward. Lasts 3 min.

The priest becomes surrounded with anti-magic energy. Any successful spell cast against the priest will burn 105 of the attacker's Mana, causing 1 Shadow damage for each point of Mana burned. Lasts 15 sec.
Heals a friendly target for 778 to 914.
Consumes the enemy in holy flames that cause 196 to 244 Holy damage and an additional 75 Holy damage over 10 sec.
Soothes the target, reducing the range at which it will attack you by 10 yards. Only affects Humanoid targets level 70 or lower. Lasts 15 sec.
Shackles the target undead enemy for up to 50 sec. The shackled unit is unable to move, attack or cast spells. Any damage caused will release the target. Only one target can be shackled at a time.

The caster is surrounded by shadows. When a spell, melee or ranged attack hits the caster, the attacker will be struck for 96 Shadow damage. Attackers can only be damaged once every few seconds. This damage causes no threat. 3 charges. Lasts 10 min.
Allows the caster to see through the target's eyes for 1 min. Will not work if the target is in another instance or on another continent.
Drains 749 to 791 mana from a target. For each mana drained in this way, the target takes 0.5 Shadow damage.

Causes an explosion of holy light around the caster, causing 181 to 208 Holy damage to all enemy targets within 10 yards and healing all party members within 10 yards for 294 to 339. These effects cause no threat.
Assault the target's mind with Shadow energy, causing 390 Shadow damage over 3 sec and slowing their movement speed by 50%.
Holy power infuses the target, increasing their Spirit by 40 for 1 hour.
Controls a humanoid mind up to level 74, but increases the time between attacks by 25%. Lasts up to 1 min.
A powerful prayer that heals the target and their party for 646 to 681. Party members must be within 40 yards of target.
Increases the target's resistance to Shadow spells by 60 for 10 min.
Attempts to cure 1 disease effect on the target, and 1 more disease effect every 5 seconds for 20 sec.
Heal yourself and a friendly target for 778 to 914. This causes low threat.
A word of dark binding that inflicts 447 to 474 Shadow damage to the target. If your target is not killed by Shadow Word: Death, you take backlash damage equal to 10% of your maximum health.

Allows the caster to levitate, floating a few feet above the ground. While levitating, you will fall at a reduced speed and travel over water-like surfaces. Mounting or any damage taken will cancel the effect. Lasts 2 min.
A slow casting spell that heals a single target for 1893 to 2108.

Creates a holy Lightwell near the priest. Members of your raid or party can click the Lightwell to restore 1600 health over 10 sec. Being attacked cancels the effect. Lightwell lasts for 3 min or 5 charges.
Launches a volley of holy light at the target, causing 92 Holy damage to an enemy, or 425 healing to an ally, instantly and every 1 sec for 2 sec.
Power infuses all party and raid members, increasing their Stamina by 70 for 1 hour.

Places a spell on the target that heals them (scales with healing power) the next time they take damage or receive non-periodic healing. When the heal occurs, Prayer of Mending jumps to a party or raid member within 20 yds. Jumps up to 5 times and lasts 30 sec after each jump. This spell can only be placed on one target at a time per caster.
Power infuses all party and raid members, increasing their Shadow resistance by 60 for 20 min.
Power infuses all party and raid members, increasing their Spirit by 40 for 1 hour.
